title: Model Insight Extractor
subtitle: Generates a large set of test prompts, runs them through the model, captures the model's internal state for each prompt, and re-runs any that failed.
lede: Generates a large set of test prompts, runs them through the model, captures the model's internal state for each prompt, and re-runs any that failed. You get a clean dataset of model internals ready for analysis.
who: A research lead studying what a model does inside
author: Corey James
